title: OnePlus confirms it will no longer operate in North America or Europe but will continue in China, while Realme, another Oppo sub-brand, will exit China (CNET)
summary: CNET: OnePlus confirms it will no longer operate in North America or Europe but will continue in China, while Realme, another Oppo sub-brand, will exit China — “Never settle” takes on a whole new meaning, as the once-maverick phone-maker retreats from the US and Europe.
